_note: Transition ECU (18 Nov 2026 air-braking investigation): fan-assisted air-braking from wing-borne flight into hover, engaged by the pilot with the 'airbrake' command. Software only: no mass, geometry or physics parameter changes. Adds lift-aware collective trim for the vertical-speed mode, turn coordination, in-flight spoileron and DRS-stabilator airbrake scheduling, a braking attitude and hover drift damping while engaged. Opt-in; variants that do not list this overlay are unchanged (identical configuration SHA, no extra random draws).

q_ramp_pa.s: dynamic pressure over which the wing-borne functions (lift relief, coordination, braking surfaces, braking attitude) fade in: 9 to 26 m/s; below 9 m/s the wing carries under 1 % of the weight

lift_estimate_tau_s.s: low-pass time constant of the measured non-fan vertical force (m (a_z + g) - fan vertical thrust); wing lift changes over seconds during braking

coordination_min_speed_m_s.s: airspeed floor in the coordinated-turn yaw rate g sin(phi) cos(theta) / V (same floor as the 9 Nov test pilot)

braking_pitch_deg.s: stick-centred pitch attitude while braking wing-borne: +4 deg, the 9 Nov V2/V3 trimmed attitude at 95 m/s; fades to level hover trim

spoileron_deg.s: symmetric aileron trailing-edge-up bias while braking; leaves 8 deg for roll on the upgoing side within the +/-20 deg travel (Moog-class actuator, handover control_limits)

stab_airbrake_te_up_deg.s: DRS stabilator increment above its 6 deg rest while braking: 55 deg total, the existing P6 ground-airbrake setting of the same actuator

brake_collective_floor.s: minimum fan collective while braking airborne (about 1 kN per fan, the 9 Nov fan load 2 s into the braking): fan ram drag is the brake and fan differential keeps pitch/roll authority

unload_pitch_rad_per_collective.s: pitch-down per unit collective by which the vertical-speed loop asks for less than the braking floor (wing unloading); 0.6 dipped the nose to -0.8 deg and spiked the braking to 1.02 g in run r4 (lift over-dumped onto the fans), 0.15 holds +2.8 to +4.5 deg

unload_pitch_max_deg.s: limit of the wing-unloading pitch offset

unload_pitch_tau_s.s: filter time constant of the wing-unloading pitch offset (slower than the 0.3 s lift estimate so the two do not overshoot together)

airbrake_priority_tau_s.s: filter on the stabilator airbrake retraction under nose-down demand (unfiltered it limit-cycled 5-55 deg at 0.5 Hz in run r2)

hover_drift_gain_rad_per_m_s.s: translational-rate damping in hover with the air-brake engaged: attitude per m/s of heading-frame ground velocity (0.86 deg per m/s; 2 deg per m/s limit-cycled +/-8 deg against the hover attitude loop in run r2)

hover_drift_tilt_max_deg.s: attitude limit of the hover drift damping
